messages:
maya: quick check putting together a few approaches for form validation on Console > Model Pins. short gif + two artboards in figma. options: inline-only, summary+inline anchors, summary-only. also required marker choices and delete confirmation copy. thoughts? dan: can you paste the screenshots here? also need mobile behaviour. maya: pasted. TL;DR: inline-only = minimal; summary+inline = accessible; summary-only = compact. two choices for required: asterisk vs explicit '(required)'. sophia: leaning summary+inline. summary gives a single place for screen readers + keyboard users. we should make the summary an alert region (role="alert" and aria-live="assertive") and move focus to it on submit. also include anchor links from summary->field. oliver: agree with summary+inline. inline hints are helpful for context after user returns to specific field. for required — do not rely on color: prefer explicit '(required)' label. marco: about deletion confirmations: for irreversible deletes (affects data/billing or multi-record deletes) use typed confirm (e.g., type DELETE). for less severe deletes, modal with checkbox + clear copy is fine. maya: @marco any numerical threshold for typed confirm? marco: use typed confirm when deletion affects > 10 records or is irreversible (billing/model artifacts). otherwise modal + checkbox. also require admin role for bulk deletes. dan: a11y nit: set aria-invalid="true" on invalid inputs and use aria-describedby to link to the error text. focus the summary on error so screen readers announce it. a11y-bot: Reminder: WCAG says don't rely on color alone. ensure required marker has non-color cue. Also check contrast on error outlines (min 3:1 for UI components). https://example.com/contrast-checker sophia: UX note: for long forms if validation >3 errors expand summary by default and mute inline hints to avoid UI noise. on mobile, consider scrolling to the first inline error because summary may be out of viewport. oliver: interaction detail: clicking a summary item should set focus to the input (not just the label) and ensure visible focus ring. add data-error-id attr for telemetry. maya: implementation question: which gets initial focus on submit fail: summary or first field? I'm leaning summary on desktop, inline scroll on mobile. dan: summary first is standard. focus summary, then tab goes to anchors. on mobile, auto-scroll to first inline error is better UX. marco: server-side errors: show persistent toast for non-validation errors (500). map API validation errors into the summary with field anchors. don't clear summary on retry unless errors resolved. maya: copy tweak: summary header: "Please fix these fields to continue" (less scary than "Errors"). typed confirm copy: "Type DELETE to permanently remove this model pin." keep short. sophia: can you add a short HTML snippet for the summary + anchors so I can run an a11y review? maya: snippet I'm planning to include: ```html

Please fix these fields to continue

  • Model name is required
  • Pin count must be a number
``` oliver: nice. include data-test-id attrs and ensure anchors call focus() on the target. sophia: i'll pair on the accessibility pass. can we also document the keyboard flow for modals and typed confirms? maya: yes. plan: update figma + write a short front-end spec (patterns, aria attrs, mobile behaviour, typed-confirm rules). posting in ~25m. :thumbsup:
